context.title: Load existing context
context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-everyone.md, references/global-orchestrator.md, references/global-crew.md) — the baseline you will elicit project deltas from — then any existing docs/agents/*, AGENTS.md, and the README/overview. Attest c1.

intent.title: Capture project intent
intent.imperative: Ask the user the project's overall intent and current development status, unless already given. Record it.

explore.title: Explore existing code
explore.imperative: If the project has code, briefly explore it to learn what is implemented. Record findings. Skip with reason if greenfield.

postconditions.statement: current implementation understood at a high level

interrogate.title: Interrogate doctrine
interrogate.imperative: Synthesize the goal: how the project wants problems approached, special crew rules, posture, standards, terms — but only where the project DEPARTS from the inherited global baseline (do not re-elicit doctrine the global buckets already state). In your own context, load constellation-interrogator and drive interrogation.json with that goal and the charter starting questions; integrate the resolved understanding.

rigor.title: Set rigor and prune
rigor.imperative: From the resolved doctrine choose the rigor level: which human checkpoints the project wants. Prune this checklist's document-confirmation checkpoints to match (owner edit), and carry the choice into the engine config.

postconditions.statement: rigor chosen; checklist pruned to it

orchestrator-context.title: Write ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT
orchestrator-context.imperative: Write docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md as project DELTAS over the inherited global doctrine — do not restate references/global-orchestrator.md or references/global-everyone.md; capture only project facts (purpose, authority), non-default rigor, and where this project departs. Confirm it with the user.

crew-context.title: Write CREW_CONTEXT
crew-context.imperative: Write docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md as project DELTAS over the inherited global doctrine — do not restate references/global-crew.md or references/global-everyone.md; capture only project rules that change implementation or review. Confirm it with the user.

glossary.title: Write GLOSSARY
glossary.imperative: Write docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md (shared terms only). Confirm it with the user.

agent-guide.title: Write AGENT_GUIDE and pointers
agent-guide.imperative: Write docs/agents/AGENT_GUIDE.md from templates/AGENT_GUIDE.template.md: the single repo-orientation guide, in three parts — why this project exists, repository organization, and the documentation map — plus portable build/test/run entry points. It answers only 'why are we here' and 'where is everything'. It must NOT carry method: no planning, evidence, verification, review, authority, or workflow doctrine, and no pointers to role context files — each skill routes its own role to its own doc, and duplicated method is conflicting method. Write Why This Exists for a reader who knows the technology but nothing about this project; name what the project is deliberately NOT, so scope drift has a boundary. The guide is for agents and README.md is for humans: do not route agents to the README, and let the two overlap where the same fact serves both readers. Keep build/test/run portable — never encode one operating system's invocation. Every sentence must stand on its own: no allusions to books, methodologies, or other products, because a reader who misses the reference gets nothing and a reader who catches it gets tone instead of meaning. Run the whole guide through `constellation-how-to-talk` before confirming: plainest word that carries the meaning, one point per sentence, no line that only repeats another. A baggy guide is a guide that stops getting read. Copy this skill's bundled references/windows.md verbatim into docs/agents/PLATFORM_NOTES.md as a durable project output (same pattern as GLOSSARY.md) so general external agents that never load a Constellation skill still have a resolvable path to platform/harness hazard doctrine; do not reference it from AGENT_GUIDE.md. Then write the root pointer files AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md from templates/AGENTS.pointer.template.md and templates/CLAUDE.pointer.template.md so every agent entry point redirects to the one guide. Confirm with the user.

postconditions.statement: AGENT_GUIDE and root pointers written and confirmed

engine-config.title: Write engine config
engine-config.imperative: Write docs/agents/engine-config.json (rework cap, rigor checkpoints, rules root, repo guidance). Confirm it with the user.

project-templates.title: Seed project templates
project-templates.imperative: Seed or update .agent-work/templates/ with project-specific template versions where the project needs them (e.g. project review criteria). Skip with reason if none needed.

closeout.title: Compile and archive
closeout.imperative: Confirm durable outputs updated, no open questions remain, contradiction pass done. Archive the work area.

postconditions.statement: durable outputs complete; work area archived
